expected.finding: **[P2]** Failure labels suppress field blind spots. In [revise-improvement-policy.py:561](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:561), prepending `tool-error` makes otherwise unclassified failures match the shell topic’s `-e` keyword. A reproduction produced five collector blind spots, zero reviser blind spots, and no revision. Classify the failure content before adding descriptive labels.

**[P2]** Evidence refreshes discard older definitions of reused topic names. [measure-policy-validity.py:150](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/measure-policy-validity.py:150) retains only one definition per name. Mining can generate `archive-branch` with different keyword lists after a rollback. Refreshing then loses the earlier definition, making its evidence unknown during ancestor comparisons. Preserve evidence by name and definition, or prevent historical name reuse.

**[P2]** Clean reviews cannot advance the policy evaluation period. The new gate in [revise-improvement-policy.py:669](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:669) requires two stamped rounds, but `archive-round.py` discards reviews without findings. Two successful clean reviews still leave the counter at zero, blocking subsequent field-driven revisions indefinitely if reviews remain clean. Persist completed clean rounds with their policy stamps.
